scope: one alias, found from a published page whose claims vanished
method: The scheduler's rebuild survey flagged /organisations/australian-department-of-defence: node live, brief_total 78, current_total 0. All 78 claim ids in the page's built_from are absent from the claims table (re-imported under new ids after re-digestion), no claim in the graph mentions the Australian department, and the node's only alias was 'Department of Defense' - the United States body, which holds 311 claims on its own node. The alias is how the matcher routed United States material onto an Australian node; the page was built from that routing.

removal.why: Names a different organisation (United States Department of Defense (DoD), 99f08514). Left in place it re-attracts that body's claims on the next import.
